rows.note: refused at open: the device compiler fails the store-address probe (ARCH-49)

tests.note: The assembler checks declared access, ownership and races for every module set; the program text of the solver measured at the M0 gate is unchanged. A defect of the Intel integrated GPU compiler found by the tests of the next package is documented and gets a self-test at device open.

packages.title: streaming generator
packages.note: merged; CPU-runtime crash traced to 3-component vector arguments of non-inlined helpers and avoided (D-050)

packages.title: initialisation
packages.note: merged; init bit-exact against the check script at time 0 in both wall modes; cell coordinate is a 4-component vector everywhere (D-050)

packages.title: core modules
packages.note: merged and accepted (D-043): rest state exact, 30-step box with walls within 1.2e-7 of the check script on three devices, plot viewed

packages.title: program integration
packages.note: merged; the program now carries the tag, init and view kernels after the fused kernels

packages.title: prototype driver
packages.note: merged and accepted; host work is 2 % of wall time at 128^3; the mass-drift outlier is 32-bit rounding of the density at 1, reproduced bit for bit by a numpy model (D-054)

packages.title: benchmark harness
packages.note: merged; harness reviewed and corrected before any gate figure was taken (D-055)

packages.title: gate: VAL-12 parity
packages.note: passed: throughput 1.016 (32-bit) and 1.005 (16-bit storage) times the baseline at 256^3, required 0.95; memory 93 and 55 bytes per cell; host work 0.6 % of wall time

packages.title: access and race checks
packages.note: the assembler now rejects module sets whose declared reads and writes do not match their code, two writers of one field, and read-after-write races; two review rounds closed five ways a hidden write could pass

packages.title: scheduler: graph and exchange placement
packages.note: the scheduler now derives, from the declared reads and writes of every pass, where halo exchanges go and which step variants exist; review found and closed two ordering defects, and the rule for two writers of one field is now stated per phase

packages.title: scheduler: consumers and validity
packages.note: diagnostics now register as consumers with their sampling steps, so the output fields are written only on the steps that need them and can be brought up to date on demand; reads inside a callback refer to the sample time; the declared access of generated code is narrowed to what the configuration really writes. Three review passes; a dangling record found by the reviewer was shown by a test and fixed

packages.title: lattice tables and modules
packages.note: five more velocity sets (two- and three-dimensional) with their device modules; tables and moment identities recomputed independently in review

packages.title: compiler self-tests at device open
packages.note: every device is tested when it is opened: a small program with a known exact result is compiled and run, and a device whose compiler gets it wrong is refused with a message that names the test; the Intel UHD 770 with its present driver is refused, the RTX 5050 and the Intel CPU runtime pass

packages.title: streaming on every lattice
packages.note: the streaming generator now serves every lattice (D2Q9, D3Q15, D3Q19, D3Q27 and the scalar sets D2Q5, D3Q7): slot tables, wall tags, initialisation and the views are compared exactly with an independent numpy oracle on the Intel CPU runtime and the RTX 5050, including two negative controls that must fail

packages.title: f16c accessor
packages.note: the second 16-bit storage format (f16c) is available: one integer-only codec shared by host and device, checked against the specification on every 32-bit pattern by the reviewer and against its 31 published vectors on both devices; two injected faults prove that a broken codec stops the run

packages.title: two-array check variant: generator
packages.note: the check variant of the streaming step exists: two copies of the populations with explicit bounce-back, built from the same collision fragments as production; its slot rules match the frozen oracles on six lattices in both wall modes, and the negative control without the second generation differs in exactly the expected elements
